messages.content:
Here is our data retention policy:

# Data retention policy

1. Application logs are kept for 30 days. Owner: Platform team.
2. Customer support tickets are kept for 2 years after closure. Owner: Support.
3. Raw analytics events are kept for 90 days. Owner: Data team.
4. Invoices are kept for 7 years to meet tax requirements. Owner: Finance.
5. Database backups are kept for 35 days. Owner: Platform team.
6. Deleted accounts are purged after 14 days. Owner: Platform team.
7. Security audit logs are kept for 1 year. Owner: Security.
8. Marketing contact lists are reviewed every 6 months. Owner: Marketing.

Which item is most likely to raise a privacy review question?

Item 2 is the most likely: keeping support tickets for 2 years after closure may be longer than needed for their purpose, and tickets often contain personal data. Be ready to justify the period or shorten it.
Change item 3 from 90 days to 60 days. Keep everything else.

Item 3 now reads:

3. Raw analytics events are kept for 60 days. Owner: Data team.

The rest of the policy is unchanged.
Also state in item 5 that the backups are encrypted.

required_facts: Item 5 now says the database backups are kept for 35 days and are encrypted, keeping the 35 days and the Platform team owner
States that the rest of the policy is unchanged (including item 3 at 60 days)
The change is locatable as item 5
critical_omissions: Changing the retention period of item 5 or any other item
Presenting a partial excerpt as the complete policy
unnecessary_repetition: Reprinting all eight items without being asked
Re-explaining the privacy review concern about item 2
